fit_reason: Whole 1986 Stratos 165 XL runabout with outboard and trailer, listed by a private owner.
findings: Hull sides look freshly washed and still wet, but the cream gelcoat along the port and starboard sides reads flat rather than glossy
Yellowing and dulling of the cream gelcoat near the transom and stern corners
Faint staining and dulling on the lower hull near the bow above the trailer bunks
Bow cushions and vinyl look clean but slightly off-white and dull in the open bow photo
Blue carpet in the bow walkway looks faded
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Stratos 165 XL. It looks well kept, but the cream gelcoat on the sides and around the transom looks a bit flat and yellowed in the photos. We do mobile gelcoat polish and pre-sale details, including the bow vinyl and carpet, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
